title: payment.payment
description: A snapshot of a Payment with its Payment transactions, published with each change. Keyed by paymentId.

eventId.description: Unique per event; the same event delivered twice has the same eventId.

occurredAt.description: When the change was published, in the transaction that made it.

paymentId.description: The Payment's ID: the message key.

version.description: The Payment's version: how many transactions it has. Apply an event only if it is newer than what you hold.

change.description: Why the event was published: the status a transaction left the Payment in, CAPTURE_DECLINED for a capture the gateway refused (the Payment stays AUTHORIZED), REFUNDED for an approved Refund (the Payment PARTIALLY_REFUNDED or REFUNDED), REFUND_DECLINED for a Refund the gateway refused (the Payment as it was), or BACKFILLED for a Payment recorded before Payment events.

status.description: Worked out from the transactions: PARTIALLY_REFUNDED once approved Refunds give back part of the captured amount, REFUNDED once they give back all of it.

declineReason.description: The gateway's reason, such as insufficient_funds, when status is DECLINED.

transactions.description: Every Payment transaction, oldest first; never changed or removed.

gatewayReference.description: The gateway's reference for this interaction.

declineReason.description: The gateway's reason, when the outcome is DECLINED.

gatewayEventId.description: The gateway's event ID, when a webhook recorded the transaction.

backfilled.description: True for an authorization reconstructed from a Payment recorded before the ledger; its at is when it was reconstructed.

reference.description: What a REFUND is for, such as an RMA reference. Absent for every other kind.

Money.description: An amount in a Currency's Minor unit (GLOSSARY.md, Money).

amountMinor.description: The amount in its Currency's Minor unit.
